BacklogState.description: Backlog reported in three states rather than one figure, so the constraint is visible as labour, procurement or operations instead of being hidden in a single number.
BacklogState.title: BacklogState

DueStatus.description: The three states on the client's own sheets: ok, soon, due. "Soon" is the amber window -- work that is not yet due but close enough that spares and vessel availability need arranging.
DueStatus.title: DueStatus

IntervalUnit.description: An interval is a value plus a unit. The client's sheets use both regimes -- "every 500 Hrs." on the Main Engine, "3 Monthly" on the Pumps -- so a single numeric frequency cannot express their schedule.
IntervalUnit.title: IntervalUnit

TaxonomyLevel.description: Five-level hierarchy of the ISO 14224 type. Depth actually used is a configuration decision -- most assets will stop at equipment unit.
TaxonomyLevel.title: TaxonomyLevel

TriggerClass.description:
| | |---| | `calendar`
Elapsed time since last completion. Due date computed automatically. | | `meter`
Running hours, cycles or sailings against the asset's meter. | | `condition`
A measured parameter crossing a configured limit. | | `event`
A defined operational occurrence -- grounding, overheat, heavy weather. | | `statutory`
A regulatory or class survey date, with an outer limit on extension. |
